correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all quantifiers and identities. Canonical greedy coin counts and the published Apéry formula hold for a=2^n+1. The new simultaneous induction on jump maxima and boundary counts is complete for every h>=1; the case split on wrap, interior, and terminal residues proves the entire pseudo-Frobenius set, including n=3. Independent Dijkstra shortest-path checks match 4097 actual Apéry residues across n=3..11, with 16368 tests of the coin-cutoff lemma; these finite checks do not prove infinity.

value.rationale: The first generator 2^n+1 is a natural Fermat-shaped counterpart of the Mersenne/repunit 2^n-1 family treated in the primary literature. The exact pseudo-Frobenius spectrum, not determined by Frobenius number/genus alone, displays a structural type drop to n-2 and a separated terminal block. The uniform result covers infinitely many n and includes the symmetry boundary at n=3.
